presence_rationale: Dedicated 'Equator Principles' section with multiple case studies and detailed integration into Project Finance approval. ANZ has been a member since 2006.
specificity_rationale: Detailed case studies (solar farms eastern AU Cat B2, southern AU Cat B2, EV battery manufacturer Europe Cat C2) with categorisation criteria (A/B/C), independent expert engagement, EP DD process, sensitive sector requirements, S&E Risk Policy. Explicit refusal-of-finance triggers. Comprehensive governance described.
quantification_rationale: Mentions case-study category counts and physical/transition risk assessment. ANZ refers to '2023 ESG Data and Frameworks Pack' for Equator Principles aggregate data — but that data is not in retrieved evidence. SASB FN-CB-410a.1 (commercial and industrial credit exposure by industry) is not disclosed in retrieved chunks.
